title: HIFU Price in Dubai: Face, Neck and Full Face
h1: HIFU price in Dubai: face, neck and face and neck
desc: HIFU prices in Dubai: Ultraformer III face or neck AED 5,000 + VAT, face and neck AED 10,000 + VAT, body from AED 4,000 + VAT, and how it compares with MPT and Ultherapy.
answer: At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina, HIFU with Ultraformer III costs AED 5,000 + VAT for the face or the neck, AED 10,000 + VAT for face and neck, and AED 4,000 + VAT per body area. The newer Ultraformer MPT costs AED 7,000 + VAT for the face or neck and AED 14,000 + VAT for both. Most people need one session, with a top-up about once a year.
body:
## What you pay for

HIFU is priced by area. One session treats the whole area at several depths, including the deep layer that a surgical facelift tightens, so most people need only one session, with the lift building over 2 to 3 months as new collagen forms. Results typically last around a year, so the yearly cost is roughly the price of one session.

## Ultraformer III prices

- **Face:** AED 5,000 + VAT
- **Neck:** AED 5,000 + VAT
- **Face and neck:** AED 10,000 + VAT
- **Body, per area:** AED 4,000 + VAT

Seasonal offers on Ultraformer III are shown on the [HIFU page](/treatments/hifu-dubai/) when they run.

## Ultraformer MPT prices

[Ultraformer MPT](/treatments/ultraformer-mpt-dubai/) is the newer generation with micro and pulsed delivery, designed to be quicker and more comfortable. It costs AED 7,000 + VAT for the face or the neck and AED 14,000 + VAT for face and neck. Both machines lift and tighten; the choice is mostly about comfort, speed and budget.

## HIFU or Ultherapy?

[Ultherapy](/treatments/ultherapy-dubai/) also uses focused ultrasound but adds real-time imaging, so the practitioner sees the tissue layers on screen. It costs AED 7,000 + VAT for the face or neck and AED 10,000 + VAT for face and neck. See [Ultherapy vs HIFU](/blog/ultherapy-vs-hifu/) for a full comparison.

## Is HIFU worth it?

HIFU gives the best value for mild to moderate laxity: a softer jawline, early jowls, a lowered brow or a loose neck. For very heavy sagging, surgery changes more, and for texture or scars, [Morpheus8](/treatments/morpheus8-dubai/) is the better spend. Your doctor tells you honestly which one suits you. Read [HIFU results by week](/blog/hifu-results-timeline/) to see what to expect.
faq: How many HIFU sessions do I need?
Usually one, with a top-up about once a year.
Why is face and neck AED 10,000 + VAT?
Each area is AED 5,000 + VAT and both are treated in one visit.
Yes. Ultraformer III is AED 5,000 + VAT for the face, Ultherapy AED 7,000 + VAT.
